notes: Three faults were losing memories quietly. Each character keeps a marker for how far through a conversation they have read, and it was being moved forward whether or not the pass that was supposed to read those messages actually worked — so a dropped connection or a reply that came back malformed retired that stretch of conversation unread, and everything you said in it was gone for good with nothing said about it. A failed pass now leaves the marker where it was and tries again on the next message, and says so in the troubleshooting log. The marker was also set to the current time rather than to the last message actually read, so anything you sent while the pass was still running was skipped — which is most of the time, since a few seconds after sending is exactly when people type the next thing. Worst of the three was group chats: the marker was kept per conversation rather than per person, so the first character to finish marked the exchange read on everyone else's behalf and the rest of the room learned nothing from a conversation they were sitting in. Each character now keeps their own. Markers written by older builds are still honoured, so nothing is re-read from scratch.
